blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Where is the laptop? Where is Sophie? At work, we ask these questions every day. In English, we use three small words to answer them: in, on and at.

We say the laptop is on the desk. We say the pens are in the drawer. We say the visitor is at reception. These three little words solve most "where" questions at work.

Today you learn five new words: desk, drawer, meeting room, reception and kitchen. We go step by step. You can do it!

items.q: How many small words do we use to answer "where"?
items.why: "we use three small words… in, on and at".

items.q: Where is the laptop?
items.why: "the laptop is on the desk".

items.q: Where are the pens?
items.why: "the pens are in the drawer".

items.q: The text suggests that in, on and at are…
options: very difficult and only for experts
useful for everyday "where" questions at work
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que essas palavrinhas resolvem a maioria das perguntas de "where" no trabalho.

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: Small words can be very useful.
You need many long words to say where something is.
In, on and at answer "where" questions.
items.why: Inferência: o texto defende que três palavrinhas curtas já bastam — o autor discordaria da ideia de precisar de muitas palavras longas.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie mostrar o escritório. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to our office. My name is Sophie. Let me show you around. Come with me.

This is my desk. My laptop is on the desk, and my phone is on the desk too. My pens are in the drawer, next to the paper. I keep small things in the drawer.

Now look over there. That is the meeting room. Tom is in the meeting room right now. He has a call at ten o'clock, so we are quiet here.

Here is reception, at the front. A visitor is at reception today. Her name is Ana, and she is here for a meeting. Please say hello to her later.

And this is the kitchen. The coffee is in the kitchen, and it is very good! I go to the kitchen every morning for a cup. The printer is in the corner, near the window.

So, that is our office. Do you want a coffee? Come, the kitchen is this way!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is Sophie's laptop?
items.why: "My laptop is on the desk."

items.q: Where are the pens?
items.why: "My pens are in the drawer, next to the paper."

items.q: Where is Tom?
items.why: "Tom is in the meeting room right now."

items.q: Why does Sophie say they are quiet?
items.why: Inferência: eles ficam quietos porque Tom tem uma ligação às dez horas.

items.q: How does Sophie sound?
items.why: Inferência: ela recebe bem, mostra tudo e oferece um café — tom simpático.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My laptop is on the desk." A desk is…
options: the front area of the office
items.why: Desk = mesa de trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We make coffee in the ___."
items.why: Kitchen = cozinha, onde fazemos café.

items.q: "The pens are in the drawer." A drawer is…
options: a small part of the desk that you open and close
items.why: Drawer = gaveta: abre e fecha e guarda coisas pequenas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We talk about the project in the ___."
items.why: Meeting room = sala de reunião, onde falamos sobre o projeto.

items.q: "The visitor is at reception." Reception is…
options: the front area where visitors arrive
the room where we make coffee
items.why: Reception = recepção, a área da frente onde as visitas chegam.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you set up the meeting room?" To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar, deixar pronto.

items.q: "Please drop by my desk later." To drop by means to…
items.why: Drop by = dar uma passadinha, visitar por pouco tempo.

items.q: "I will follow up with an email." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, mandar mais informação depois.

items.q: "Let's check in at ten o'clock." To check in means to…
options: have a short talk about progress
items.why: Check in = fazer um alinhamento rápido para ver como estão as coisas.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.
